Agent Name: Assistant
, Step Number: 33
, Reason for Mistake: The Assistant misinterpreted the question’s criterion by checking whether a director had ever held a corporate C‑suite role, instead of whether they were in a C‑suite position at their company when they joined Apple’s board. Relying on an inaccurate/outdated third-party page and conflating Andrea Jung with “Andrea Young” compounded the confusion, leading to the incorrect conclusion (Al Gore) rather than the correct set (Wanda Austin, Ronald D. Sugar, Sue Wagner).
